text:
Maya: Heads up — OrionCloud just flagged a customs hold on a portion of our latest inbound rack shipment (PO 78910). ~40% of racks are on hold in AMS. We have reserved capacity committed to two SI onboardings next Tues/Wed. Need quick allocation decision and comms plan. @Samir @Julia @Liam

Samir: On it. Can we confirm exact units affected and which reservations are tied to those racks? I can reassign marketplace pool if needed.

Liam: I have the container IDs, need to escalate clearance. pinging partner ops now. container: CMAU1234567

OpsBot: Shipment update received from OrionCloud: PO 78910 — 4/10 racks cleared, 6/10 held at customs (AMS). ETA pending clearance. Link: https://orcloud.status/po/78910

Julia: For the SI rollouts — SI-A needs 2 racks (networked staging), SI-B can operate on 1 rack in soft-mode for first pass. If we hold 2 racks aside for SI-A we can stagger SI-B by 48h.

Maya: Propose: hold 2 racks for SI-A (critical go-live), reassign 4 racks to marketplace burst pool for high-usage customers, leave 0 in transit reserve, and keep 4 pending priority by ETA. Thoughts?

Samir: Agree with hold 2. I'll run reassign. Command I'll use:
```
resv-cli reassign --resv R-7789 --from reserved --to marketplace --qty 4
resv-cli set-hold --resv R-7790 --qty 2 --reason "SI-A critical"
```
Expect changes to reflect in 10m.

Liam: Partner responded — submitted customs docs, estimated clearance window 24-72h. I'm requesting expedited lane. ETA update likely tomorrow morning.

Julia: I'll push SI-B onboarding tasks that don't require full rack — config + evals can go ahead. Ping me when Samir confirms new resv ids.

Maya: I'll draft customer comms for SI-A & SI-B and a banner for marketplace users. Use sympathetic tone + ETA window + remediation credits if delay >72h. Draft in #customer-success after we lock numbers.

OpsBot: Reminder: update /status page and alert CS once Samir confirms reassign.

Samir: Reassign done. New marketplace allocation id: MKT-9123. Held for SI-A: R-HOLD-334. see dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/allocations/R-HOLD-334

Maya: Great — final plan: 2 racks reserved for SI-A, 4 moved to marketplace, remaining 4 queued for expedited clearance. Julia moves SI-B to staggered 48h schedule. Liam continues clearance. I'll post comms in 20m. :thumbsup:

Liam: Noted. I'll update if customs gives an ETA change.

Julia: I'll adjust runbook and notify SI integrator.

Maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if ETA slips past 72h.
